data.jd_text:
A private investment platform with an established real estate portfolio is seeking an experienced executive to lead the next phase of growth and capital deployment.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity to work directly alongside principals in a highly entrepreneurial environment, taking ownership of both portfolio performance and new investment activity. The role combines investment leadership, operational oversight, and strategic execution within a lean, agile platform.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Lead the day\-to\-day management and performance of an existing real estate portfolio
* Identify, evaluate, and execute new investment opportunities across multiple real estate sectors
* Drive capital allocation, portfolio optimisation, refinancing, and exit strategies
* Oversee underwriting, due diligence, transaction execution, and post\-acquisition asset management
* Work closely with principals on investment strategy, risk management, and long\-term value creation
* Build and maintain relationships with developers, operating partners, lenders, investors, and advisors
* Establish scalable processes and governance appropriate for a high\-performing private investment platform



  





 Ideal Background
 



  




* 15\+ years of experience in real estate investments, development, asset management, or principal investing
* Demonstrated track record sourcing, executing, and managing direct real estate investments
* Experience operating within a family office, private investment firm, developer, sovereign wealth fund, pension fund, private equity platform, or institutional investor
* Strong commercial judgement and ability to operate autonomously
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, principal\-led environment with high accountability
* Experience across acquisitions, asset management, capital structuring, and portfolio management
* GCC experience is advantageous but not essential

Chief Product Officer (CPO)
 
 We are looking for a highly experienced, hands\-on, and entrepreneurial Chief Product Officer (CPTO) to join us in a leadership capacity and transform our existing B2B Operating system into a much more scalable, AI\-powered SaaS ecosystem.
 



 This is a senior level opportunity for a strong technology and product leader who can independently drive the complete product and technology function — from architecture and roadmap to execution, hiring, delivery, and scale. The role requires someone who can work closely with the founders, support investor discussions, and ensure the product is delivered with speed, quality, and long\-term business value.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are currently in the scaling phase. Our existing platform has already been developed and deployed, and we are now looking for a very senior technology leader to come on board on a sweat equity basis initially and lead the next stage of growth.
 



 The selected candidate will take ownership of rebuilding and evolving the current solution into a more scalable, secure, AI\-led, and value\-driven business operating system. This person will be expected to build the team, hire the right people, establish delivery processes, and lead the entire product lifecycle independently.
 


 What You Will Build
 
 The mandate is to lead the development of an Odoo\- based AI Business Operating System SaaS platform, which may include:
 


* AI Website Builder
* AI SEO / GEO Engine
* Lead Magnet System
* AI Chat Agent
* CRM Integration
* Email Automation
* Prospecting AI
* AI SDR Agent
* Proposal Generator
* Contract Negotiation AI
* Multi\-channel Lead Capture
* Customer Support AI
* Merchant Acquisition Agent
* SEO Growth Agent
* Predictive Intelligence
* Revenue Agent
* Executive Dashboard
* Agent Marketplace
* Migration of existing customers to the upgraded platform


 Key Responsibilities
 * Own and define the overall technology vision, product architecture, and execution roadmap for the company.
* Lead the complete product lifecycle, including planning, architecture, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and scale.
* Transform the current B2B eStore builder into a more robust, scalable, secure, and AI\-powered SaaS solution.
* Build, hire, lead, and mentor the engineering, product, and technical delivery teams required for execution.
* Set up engineering standards, delivery systems, technical governance, and best practices across development and infrastructure.
* Take responsibility for product delivery timelines, execution quality, and go\-live commitments.
* Work closely with founders to align product strategy with market opportunity, customer needs, and commercial priorities.
* Support founders during investor meetings, technical due diligence, strategic presentations, and roadmap discussions.
* Drive platform scalability, security, system reliability, and long\-term architectural strength.
* Oversee migration of existing users and ensure operational continuity during platform evolution.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and integrate relevant innovations into the product ecosystem.


 Requirements
 * Proven experience in a senior technology leadership role Head of Technology,
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Python, Odoo, SaaS architecture, and end\-to\-end product development.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling SaaS products, platforms, or technology\-led businesses.
* Deep understanding of system architecture, infrastructure, scalability, security, and operational reliability.
* Strong experience managing end\-to\-end product execution across roadmap, development, deployment, and iteration.
* Experience hiring and building high\-performing technical teams from the ground up.
* Ability to independently lead execution while also collaborating closely with founders and business stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical strategy in a business and investor\-friendly manner.
* Experience working in startup, growth\-stage, or high\-ownership environments where speed and adaptability are critical.


 Technical Expertise
 * Python and Odoo framework development
* Custom Odoo module development
* PostgreSQL / PSQL optimization
* AWS or similar cloud infrastructure
* Nginx, Apache, DNS, SSL, and domain mapping
* Linux / Ubuntu server environments
* API integrations with payment gateways, shipping providers, CRMs, and third\-party services
* Frontend technologies including HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, jQuery, and JavaScript
* AI / ML integrations in SaaS products
* eCommerce and multi\-tenant SaaS platform experience


 What You Will Get
 * A senior leadership position at the core of the company as CPO
* Meaningful sweat equity with strong long\-term upside
* Opportunity to independently build, lead, and deliver a high\-value AI SaaS platform
* Full ownership of the product and technology function
* Authority to build your own team and hire key technical talent
* Direct involvement in strategic decisions, company growth, and investor\-facing conversations
* Competitive salary package to be introduced upon investor onboarding or funding secured
* A chance to shape a category\-defining platform from an early growth stage

 MARE Properties L.L.C. is a Dubai\-based real estate firm focused on exclusive developments and premium investments that shape the city’s future skyline. **Chief of Staff to the Founding Partners** 




  





 SV7 is a Kuwait\-based group operating across the GCC and internationally, originating and advising on opportunities at the intersection of infrastructure, strategic advisory, and digital commerce.
 



  





 We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be a second mind to the founding partners — someone who sees around corners, owns problems end to end, and moves between financial analysis, strategy, business development, and operations in the course of a single day.
 



  





 This isn’t an administrative role. It’s a high\-trust, high\-autonomy seat for someone exceptional who wants proximity to the founding partners, real ownership, and exposure across industries.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  





 • Act as the founding partners’ right hand across all entities — turning high\-level direction into action, and exercising their judgment when they can’t be in the room.
 



 • Own strategic projects end to end: structuring deals, building financial models, drafting term sheets and proposals, and pressure\-testing decisions before they’re made.
 



 • Run point on business development — preparing briefs, managing partner and counterparty relationships, and keeping multi\-track initiatives moving.
 



 • Build the analysis behind major decisions — financial, commercial, and operational — with rigor and precision.
 



 • Work ten steps ahead, surfacing risks, opportunities, and decisions before they become urgent.
 



 • Represent the founding partners at a senior level, internally and externally, with discretion and polish.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




  





 • A sharp, strategic mind that thinks in systems, frameworks, and second\-order consequences.
 



 • Strong financial and commercial fluency — comfortable building models, reading deals, and reasoning about structure.
 



 • Exceptional written and verbal communication — able to move from a board\-level memo to a vendor negotiation without dropping the standard.
 



 • Thorough, detailed, and action\-oriented — you see things through from end to end.
 



 • Extreme ownership: when something lands on your desk, it’s handled.
 



 • Range across industries — a generalist who goes deep fast.
 



 • Sound judgment and total discretion; much of this work is sensitive.
 



 • Background in consulting, banking, private equity, or a founder’s office is a strong plus.
 



  





**Who you are** 




 Forward\-thinking, dependable, and unflappable. You want to be close to the decisions that matter, and you’re energized — not overwhelmed — by breadth and pace.
 



  





 📍 Based in Kuwait City · Full\-time, on\-site
 



 Interested — or know someone who'd be a great fit? Send your CV to info@sv\-7\.com or message me directly.

data.jd_text:
This role is designed for academic leaders who prefer to design the system rather than critique it from the sidelines. You bring subject\-matter fluency sufficient to define high\-quality learning, the rigor to translate that vision into rubrics and AI\-driven quality measures, and the operational discipline to act decisively on imperfect data. You prioritize measurable student progress and accept accountability for those results.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning pursues an approach seldom seen in software or education. There are no teachers, no textbooks, and no traditional instructional scaffolding beneath the platform. AI serves as the operational foundation. In this position, you deploy it to produce and refine learning content, architect interventions, oversee quality assurance, and advance platform capabilities. The tempo resembles high\-performance environments in technology, consulting, or finance rather than conventional schooling, and the reward is complete ownership of student outcomes for your subject across multiple campuses.
   

  

 This position centers on functional leadership. You will develop AI\-enhanced learning ecosystem improvements, execute student\-performance\-driven interventions, author evidence\-backed decision documentation, and lead a team measured against objective benchmarks tied to MAP, AP, SAT, and ISEE performance. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data science teams to shape platform evolution. It suits individuals who instinctively turn to AI, conduct their own analyses, deliver under uncertainty, and assume full responsibility for outcomes. It will not suit those who favor consensus\-driven timelines, minimal accountability, or reliance on established frameworks.
   

  

 You will hold a central leadership position within the academics organization, wielding meaningful influence over subject\-area performance and the broader learning infrastructure. Colleagues will depend on your standards, judgment, and capacity to translate student data into executable plans. If that prospect feels motivating rather than daunting, this role is likely aligned with your strengths.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Learning Ecosystem Enhancements — AI\-generated refinements to K–12 subject\-specific learning experiences, spanning content, adaptive pathways, and student interventions, informed by student feedback, analytics, assessments, and coaching observations.
* Data\-Driven Academic Interventions — Targeted intervention strategies for underperforming students or cohorts, guided by MAP, AP, SAT, ISEE, and related performance metrics.
* Student Performance Decision Records — Reusable, evidence\-supported decisions that document actions taken to improve student performance, backed by dashboards, analytics, tickets, surveys, coaching interactions, and assessment results.
* Learning Ecosystem Improvement Specs — Actionable specifications for product, engineering, and data science enhancements, featuring problem definitions, supporting data, anticipated student impact, and acceptance criteria.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Repackaging traditional education with an AI veneer. This is not about digitizing classroom instruction – we are reimagining learning fundamentally.
* Conducting data analysis in a vacuum. You will engage directly and regularly with K\-12 students, treating their feedback as critical input from our paying customers.
* Waiting for consensus before advancing bold ideas. You will advocate for an ambitious vision and mobilize others through data\-driven outcomes.
* Adhering to conventional pedagogical methods. You will have the freedom to explore novel approaches to motivation, assessment, and instruction.
* Viewing AI as a threat to education. Here, you will leverage AI as a transformative tool to redefine learning experiences.


**Head Of Curriculum Key Responsibilities**
 Lead innovation in AI\-powered, teacher\-independent education to achieve outstanding student outcomes across multiple campuses. Integrate data analytics with consistent student engagement to refine our learning ecosystem continuously, as evidenced by AP exam results and MAP assessment growth.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Master's degree or higher in Educational Science, Learning Science, Psychology, Psychometrics, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 5 years of experience in academic or EdTech leadership roles, with direct people management responsibility (hiring, performance evaluation, coaching, termination decisions)
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools as part of day\-to\-day professional workflows, and willingness to rely on AI extensively to improve academic and operational outcomes.
* Strong understanding of learning science principles, such as Cognitive Load Theory and Mayer's Multimedia Principles, and data\-driven educational approaches


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

Job description:
   

  


     
   

**JOB PURPOSE:**
 To lead the development and execution of all of EGA’s operational and technical training initiatives for all operational training systems within EGA, ensuring alignment with corporate and operational goals.
 



  
 



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
 Strategic Development
 



  

 •    Drive the formulation and implementation of operational \& technical training strategies that align with EGA’s overall strategy, Human Capital and Talent Management.
 



 Safety, Quality, and Environmental Compliance
   

 •    Ensure adherence to all safety, quality, and environmental management policies and procedures within the department to uphold employee safety and regulatory compliance.
   

 •    Ensure all training materials are compliant with internal and external requirements for all operational areas across EGA
 



 Regulatory Compliance and Quality Assurance
   

 •    Ensure all training programs meet international and local regulatory standards and promote a culture of quality within the technical training team.
   

 •    Liaise with relevant government entities (e.g., KHDA, ACTVET) to secure recognition for EGA’s technical courses and advance the establishment of EGA as a recognized Training Academy.
 



 Training Management
   

 •    Oversee the design and management of a comprehensive training curriculum for operational and technical skill development across all Areas of EGA UAE, including JA, AT and ATA operations.
   

 •    Oversee the thorough training needs analyses to identify and deliver training programs for non\-supervisory operational employees and National Trainees
   

 •    Lead the design and development of technical and operational training courses, and acquire necessary training materials to facilitate cost\-effective delivery.
   

 •    Implement systems ensuring that 30% of operations employees are prepared for their next roles to minimize operational disruptions due to vacancies.
   

 •    Manage the Labour Training pool, including recruitment and selection, training and deployment into the Areas for approximately 150 employees at any one time
   

 •    Manage approximately 140 National Trainees for various training programs on behalf of EGA
   

 •    Ensure the availability of suitable training equipment, resources, and qualified personnel across EGA’s three sites to meet both short\- and long\-term manpower development objectives.
 



 Training Innovation and strategy 
   

 •    Lead the identification and development of modern training tools aligned with Industry 4\.0 technologies, such as AR, VR, MR, and simulators.
 



 On\-Job Excellence
   

 •    Lead the design and execution of the On\-Job Excellence program with 30 on\-job coaches supporting operations
   

 •    Monitor and report on progress of skill upgrades and readiness for new employees
 



 Budget Management
   

 •    Prepare and recommend the annual budget for the Technical and Operations Training for EGA (approximately US$4\-5M), analysing data to support funding requests on behalf of all of EGA operational areas
   

 •    Monitor financial performance against budget, identifying and addressing areas of concern while capitalizing on improvement opportunities.
 



 Collaboration and Coordination
   

 •    Collaborate with various plant areas to ensure that training aligns with operational needs, supporting EHS, Emiratisation, Recruitment, and Workforce Planning departments.
 



 Emiratisation Initiatives
   

 •    Design and implement technical training programs for Graduate and Non\-Graduate National trainees, focusing on achieving Emiratisation targets and promoting gender diversity.
   

 •    Manage the training and development of approximately 180 National Trainees through various programs, ensuring clear career pathways and regular engagement with senior leadership.
   

 •    Oversee the design, development and execution of the National Traineeship Program covering all a diverse range of technical requirements across of EGA, including Operations, Power, Maintenance, ATA, Casthouse, Administration, Fire \& Rescue and Technical Laboratory \& Quality
 



 Staff Development
   

 •    Coach and mentor the Technical and Operational Training staff to enhance their skills and capabilities.
 



 Reporting and Communication
   

 •    Provide regular updates to HC management on training plans, progress, and activities, ensuring accurate documentation and timely reporting of critical issues that may impact operations.
 



  

  
 



**AUTHORITY/ DECISION MAKING:**
     Know\-How: The job holder must possess a deep understanding of EGA’s operational and technical requirements, training methodologies, operational standards, and industry regulations. This knowledge enables the individual to interpret policies effectively and determine the best approaches to implement them within the training framework.
 



     Problem Solving: Working within clearly defined policies and objectives, the job holder is responsible for identifying what needs to be done to achieve organisational wide goals. This involves establishing actionable plans, prioritizing tasks, and prescribing processes to address training needs. The role requires critical thinking to assess potential risks and devise solutions that align with EGA’s strategic objectives.
 



     Accountability: The decisions made by the job holder can have significant implications for both safety and financial performance within operations. The individual is accountable for ensuring that training initiatives support operational excellence and mitigate risks. This level of responsibility requires a strong commitment to upholding safety standards and delivering results that align with corporate goals.
 



  
 



**QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS:**
 Minimum Qualifications:
   

     Bachelor’s degree preferably in Human Resources, Business Management or Engineering. Approved qualification in training design and delivery is preferable.
 



 Minimum Experience:
   

     10\-12 years relevant experience in operations and technical training and development including at least 3 years in positions of progressively increasing managerial responsibilities.
 



  
 



 Skills:
   

     Leadership Skills
   

     Strong skills in building relationships and engaging others;
   

     Ability to coach and deliver technical training; 
   

     Knowledge of Smelting Process Operations
   

     Environment, Health and Safety Focus
   

     Problem solving and decision making
   

     Capable of leading a large and diverse team 
   

     Planning and organizational skills, action\-oriented, service focused

Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly experienced and visionary Director of Lighting to lead and elevate the lighting design across our dynamic portfolio of projects. This leadership role is critical in ensuring that lighting is not only a functional element but also a transformative aspect of design that enhances ambiance, safety, and the overall guest experience.
   

  

 As the Director \- Lighting, you will be responsible for developing lighting strategies, managing a talented team of lighting designers, and collaborating closely with architects, engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver innovative and sustainable lighting solutions that align with Qiddiya's mission and brand identity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and oversee the implementation of comprehensive lighting design strategies across all projects at Qiddiya
* Lead, mentor, and manage the lighting design team to ensure creativity, excellence, and efficiency
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate lighting effectively with architecture, landscape, and interior design
* Ensure all lighting designs comply with relevant codes, sustainability standards, and quality requirements
* Review and approve lighting design proposals, making sure they meet aesthetic, technical, and budgetary goals
* Stay informed on emerging lighting technologies, trends, and best practices, promoting their adoption within the organization
* Manage relationships with external consultants, vendors, and contractors to ensure successful project delivery
* Prepare and present reports and presentations to executive leadership, updating on project progress and innovations in lighting design


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Lighting Design, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in lighting design and leadership roles, preferably within large\-scale projects
* Proven track record of managing complex lighting design projects from concept to completion
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and team management skills
* Advanced proficiency with lighting design software and tools such as Dialux, Relux, AutoCAD, BIM/Revit, and Adobe Creative Suite
* Strong understanding of lighting technologies, energy efficiency, and sustainable design principles
* Ability to effectively collaborate across disciplines and manage stakeholder expectations
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and a creative, innovative approach to lighting design challenges


**Benefits**
 Comprehensive benefits package
